extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: EuroSAT is a land use and land cover classification dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images. It covers 13 spectral bands and consists of 10 classes with a total of 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber (TU Kaiserslautem, Germany; German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Germany); Benjamin Bischke (TU Kaiserslautem, Germany; German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Germany); Andreas Dengel (TU Kaiserslautem, Germany; German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Germany); Damian Borth (German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Germany)
extraction.citeAs: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth. Introducing EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Leaming Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification In Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS), 2018 IEEE Intemational . IEEE, 2018.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded via Amazon S3, specifically selecting Sentinel-2A images associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas across 34 European countries.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral satellite images taken by the Sentinel-2A satellite, covering 13 spectral bands.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: A classification system trained with 64x64 image patches does not allow a finely graduated per-pixel segmentation; The proposed dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and classification system can benefit urban area development, nature protection, and sustainable development, such as detecting deforested land to notice illegal clearing of forests and address climate change.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Land use and land cover classification; Detecting land use and land cover changes; Improving geographical maps; Assisting in mapping by verifying tagged areas or identifying mistagged areas; Urban area development, nature protection, and sustainable development.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice.
